notes.title: protoViolence Patch 1.11
notes.notes:
​Small bugfixes that account for the new Ren'Py update - among other things.

[list]
[*]     Fixed a text error in one of Deidre's diary entries.
[*]     Fixed window display issues for Deidre's diary entries
[*]     Fixed speechbubble display issues throughout the visual novel
[*]     Edited the phone dismiss transition. Unfortunately, I couldn't preserve the original transition, so it simply disappears when dismissed.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing: The Official Violence Series Social Media!
notes.notes:
To celebrate [i]protoViolence[/i] participating in this year's [i]Storyteller's Festival, [/i] the [i]Violence[/i] series [url=https://linktr.ee/violenceseries]has just released its official social media presence![/url] Both [i]malViolence[/i] and [i]protoViolence[/i] have also been updated with these new platforms - hence this update post!

Look forward to series updates, memes and other fun little goodies on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/violenceseries.bsky.social]BlueSky,[/url] [url=https://violence-series.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/zdUKEerXwr]Discord.[/url] 

Thank you so much for supporting the [i]Violence[/i] series, and I hope you enjoy these new places to talk about it!

-Mado
